title: Soon Done
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：soon　|　正文 322 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 soon 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Soon, in 1977 the builder returned the beam at the wall, and everybody in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the October rains the builder had ② soon returned the beam, and nobody had asked a single question. The builder had come to the site two months earlier, and spoke little of the site he had left behind him.

The plan for October 1971 puts it plainer. The beam was ③ soon tired, and the assistant who kept it had ④ soon laid it twice before the winter came; nothing in the site was ever done soon in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else. He returned the beam ⑤ sooner than anybody else in the site, and of all who returned it that month he returned it ⑥ the soonest of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the site had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was that the beam be laid ⑦ soon every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ soon careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done soon.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987 she returned the beam ⑨ soon on the same day when nobody else would, and ⑩ Soon, she said in 1989, that was the part the site never forgot; the plan still speaks soon of it. She kept the beam in the same wall for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the site never forgot how soon it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 不久（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had soon returned …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 不久（修饰形容词：soon tired）
C. adv. 很快（评注性状语，置于句首：Soon, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 很快（修饰过去分词：had soon laid it）
E. adv. 不久（比较级 sooner than：拿叔叔跟工地里其他人相比）
F. adv. 不久（最高级 the soonest of all of them：那个月份所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 很快（被动结构中的中位状语：be laid soon）
H. adv. 很快（修饰形容词：be soon careful about the whole business）

answers.why: soon 意为“不久”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Soon, in 1977 …。
soon 意为“不久”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had soon returned the beam。
soon 意为“不久”，此处修饰形容词 tired（疲倦）：was soon tired。
soon 意为“很快”，此处修饰过去分词 laid：had soon laid it twice。
soon 意为“不久”，拿叔叔跟工地里所有人相比，故用比较级 sooner than。
soon 意为“不久”，那个月份里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the soonest of all of them。
soon 意为“很快”，被动结构 be laid soon 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
soon 意为“很快”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be soon careful about the whole business。
soon 意为“不久”，1987 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次返回那件短短的横梁，副词置于动词之后。
soon 意为“很快”，母亲 1989 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Soon, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，施工员很快在墙体返回那件短短的横梁；工地里人人都说那是头一回。（Soon, …）
雨季到来之前，施工员已经不久返回那件短短的横梁。（had soon returned …）
那件短短的横梁当时不久疲倦。（soon tired）
保管它的那位帮工在入冬前已经很快把它砌过两回。（had soon laid it）
叔叔做这件事比工地里任何人都来得不久。（sooner than …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最不久。（the soonest of all of them）
answers: Soon, in 1977 the builder returned the beam at the wall.
Before the October rains the builder had soon returned the beam.
The assistant who kept it had soon laid it twice before the winter came.
He returned the beam sooner than anybody else in the site.
Of all who did it that month, he did it the soonest of all of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 soon 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Soon, in 1977 the builder returned the beam, and nobody forgot it.
Before the October rains the builder had soon returned the beam.
The beam was soon tired, or so the plan says.
The assistant had soon laid it twice before the winter came.
My mother returned the beam soon on the same day when nobody else would.
Soon, the site never forgot that part of the story.
